prediction_baseline_definition: TCGA OS development is indexed at initial pathologic diagnosis. Clinical inference must explicitly attest that the imaging study timestamp and clinical prediction baseline correspond to that same diagnosis baseline; otherwise survival inference is blocked.

patient_id.meaning: Source patient key used only for linkage and grouped validation.
patient_id.missing: Reject records without a source patient identifier.

MSK-CHORD.LUAD: LUAD or CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED exactly Lung Adenocarcinoma
MSK-CHORD.LUSC: LUSC or CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED exactly Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma
MSK-CHORD.excluded: Broad NSCLC, ambiguous/multiple sample diagnoses, non-lung cancer

mappings.TCGA-LUAD: Cohort membership; not a discriminative predictor
mappings.TCGA-LUSC: Cohort membership; not a discriminative predictor

histology.missing: Exclude uncertain/conflicting target labels; never infer from survival or imaging.

age_at_baseline_years.meaning: Age at initial pathologic diagnosis, used as the TCGA OS time origin.
age_at_baseline_years.allowed: 18 through 120 inclusive; other values are not model eligible

mappings.MSK-CHORD: CURRENT_AGE_DEID is not mapped: its relation to diagnosis/baseline is not established

age_at_baseline_years.missing: Preserve as missing; fitted training-only median imputation is model-specific.

sex_at_baseline.meaning: Sex field as recorded by the source, not a broader gender identity construct.

mappings.MSK-CHORD: GENDER; excluded from the TCGA-only survival model

sex_at_baseline.missing: Preserve missingness; no inference from patient identifiers.

stage_at_baseline.meaning: Pathologic stage documented at initial diagnosis; retain substage distinctions.

mappings.MSK-CHORD: STAGE_HIGHEST_RECORDED is excluded because its measurement time is unknown

stage_at_baseline.missing: Preserve missingness; do not substitute clinical stage or latest/future stage.

kps_category.meaning: Karnofsky Performance Status category; direct measurements preferred.
kps_category.missing: Missing if neither valid direct KPS nor an approved ECOG conversion is available.

smoking_history.meaning: Source-recorded tobacco smoking history; original value retained.

mappings.TCGA-LUAD: patient/tobacco_smoking_history; numeric source coding requires a verified codebook
mappings.TCGA-LUSC: patient/tobacco_smoking_history; numeric source coding requires a verified codebook
mappings.MSK-CHORD: SMOKING_PREDICTIONS_3_CLASSES is a derived prediction, not an observed smoking history

smoking_history.missing: Do not decode or combine values without source documentation.

overall_survival_time_days.meaning: Days from initial pathologic diagnosis to death or last known alive.

mappings.MSK-CHORD: OS_MONTHS/OS_STATUS; excluded pending verified endpoint origin/definitions and permitted use

overall_survival_time_days.missing: No event/time imputation. Exclude invalid, negative, unknown, or contradictory endpoint records.

overall_survival_event.meaning: Death event indicator for the OS endpoint; 1=death, 0=right censored.

mappings.MSK-CHORD: OS_STATUS; not harmonized in this release

overall_survival_event.missing: Never infer event from a missing follow-up field.

imaging_candidate_count.meaning: Number of records in the validated Imaging contract nodules array.
imaging_candidate_count.missing: Not imputed. Not a malignant-nodule count and not currently a trained predictor.

largest_reported_nodule_diameter_mm.meaning: Largest non-null diameter_mm among Imaging contract nodule records.
largest_reported_nodule_diameter_mm.missing: Missing if no nodule has a reported diameter; not currently a trained predictor.

excluded: kps_category: observed in only a small minority at baseline
smoking_history: source numeric codes lack a verified codebook
imaging_candidate_count and largest_reported_nodule_diameter_mm: no patient-linked, harmonized training measurements

transformations.time: TCGA source durations already expressed in days; no unit conversion.
transformations.stage: Trim surrounding whitespace only; preserve original stage distinctions.
transformations.performance_status: See performance_status_mapping_version in harmonization.py; ECOG conversion is an approximate interval, never an exact KPS score.
transformations.source_pooling: Only the two TCGA cohorts may enter the initial OS development workflow, using the same GDC XML endpoint definition. MSK-CHORD is not pooled.
